scenes.narration: The numbers of the form a by b, where a and b are natural numbers, are called fractions. In a by b, we call a the numerator and b the denominator. Here is 2 by 3. The numerator is 2. The denominator is 3.
scenes.captions: The numbers of the form a/b, where a and b are natural numbers, are called fractions. In a/b, we call a the numerator and b the denominator. Here is 2/3. The numerator is 2. The denominator is 3.

scenes.narration: Two or more fractions representing the same part of a whole are called equivalent fractions. Look at 1 by 2. Now look at 9 by 18. They cover the same part of the bar! So 1 by 2 and 9 by 18 are equivalent fractions.
scenes.captions: Two or more fractions representing the same part of a whole are called equivalent fractions. Look at 1/2. Now look at 9/18. They cover the same part of the bar! So 1/2 and 9/18 are equivalent fractions.

scenes.narration: How do we get an equivalent fraction? We multiply or divide the numerator and the denominator by the same nonzero number. 1 times 9 is 9. 2 times 9 is 18. So 1 by 2 equals 9 by 18.
scenes.captions: How do we get an equivalent fraction? We multiply or divide the numerator and the denominator by the same nonzero number. 1 × 9 = 9. 2 × 9 = 18. So 1/2 = 9/18.

scenes.narration: We can divide too. Divide 21 and 35 by 7, and you get 3 by 5. Your book says the simplest form of 21 by 35 is 3 by 5.
scenes.captions: We can divide too. Divide 21 and 35 by 7, and you get 3/5. Your book says the simplest form of 21/35 is 3/5.

scenes.narration: A fraction whose numerator is less than its denominator is called a proper fraction. Otherwise, it is called an improper fraction. 9 by 8 is improper. A mixed fraction is a whole number plus a fraction. 9 by 8 is one whole and 1 by 8 more, so 9 by 8 equals 1 and 1 by 8.
scenes.captions: A fraction whose numerator is less than its denominator is called a proper fraction. Otherwise, it is called an improper fraction. 9/8 is improper. A mixed fraction = a whole number + a fraction. 9/8 is one whole and 1/8 more, so 9/8 = 1 1/8.
